title: PROVEN Skincare vs. Curology: Which is Better? | PROVEN Skincare
summary: Compare PROVEN Skincare and Curology to make an informed choice on which custom skincare brand suits you best.
body_markdown:
Check out this comparison of PROVEN vs. Curology to get an idea of the key features that set PROVEN apart from our competitors.


## Overview


**PROVEN**


PROVEN Skincare is a science-backed skincare brand that utilizes a data-driven approach to create personalized skincare. We own a patent for our machine-learning algorithms, which formulate our products to tackle a wide array of skin concerns from[acne](https://www.provenskincare.com/skin-concern/acne/) , anti-aging, rosacea, and dark spots to[hyperpigmentation](https://www.provenskincare.com/skin-concern/hyperpigmentation-on-face/) ,[wrinkles](https://www.provenskincare.com/skin-concern/fine-lines-and-wrinkles/) , and more. Our formulas are tailored to customers based on factors including eating and drinking habits, location and environment, stress levels, frequency of travel, skin tone, etc. Taking all of these into consideration, we incorporate 30+ active ingredients that scientific research has shown to be effective for your unique needs. With the key ingredients in place, we streamline your skincare routine down to three key products—cleanser, moisturizer with SPF, and night cream. We’re the perfect choice for those seeking an individualized, results-driven approach to addressing their skincare needs.


**Curology**


Curology was founded by David Lortscher, a dermatologist who recognized the need for more affordable skincare solutions. Curology formulations use prescription-strength products to address two of the most common skin concerns: acne and aging. (In contrast, PROVEN targets various concerns including uneven skin tone, dry skin, hyperpigmentation, sensitivity, and more.) Instead of harnessing advanced technology, scientific research, and AI to formulate products, Curology has a different process, centered around their Curology providers. Customers are required to take a brief quiz and upload photos of their skin so that a provider can prescribe a custom formula. That said, they only use three active ingredients for their acne line, which provides limitations to creating an effective routine that comprehensively addresses your skin concerns.


## Pricing


**PROVEN**


Our 3-step skincare system—which features a[face cleanser](https://www.provenskincare.com/personalized-face-cleanser/) ,[moisturizer with SPF](https://www.provenskincare.com/personalized-day-moisturizer/) , and[night cream](https://www.provenskincare.com/personalized-night-cream/) —costs $130 for a two-month supply. We don’t require customers to hold a subscription and you can pause or cancel deliveries at any time.


**Curology**


Curology's custom formula requires a subscription, and costs upwards of $59.90 for a two-month supply. They offer just two products in their personalized skincare line: acne cream and anti-aging serum. Although they offer a trial period, once it ends, your shipments are automatically scheduled and shipped every 60 days.


Last updated 6/5/23, source: https://support.curology.com/en_us/pricing-and-products-BJOLQnd2O


### The Verdict: Save Your Money With PROVEN Results


PROVEN’s patented technology identifies the best active ingredients for your skin type and concerns—beyond acne and anti-aging. You’ll start your skincare journey with lower concentrations to help your skin acclimate and minimize future breakouts. Then, you’ll progress with new, dynamic formulations at the same cost as the beginning of your journey, saving you the precious time and money required to experiment with dozens of new products.


## Technology & Patents


**PROVEN**


Our skincare approach is simple but comprehensive. In our award-winning Skin Genome Quiz™, you'll answer questions about your eating and drinking habits, your skin history, your stress levels, and your travel frequency, along with real-time environmental factors associated with your zip code (climate, pollution, UV index, humidity levels, and more). This helps us account for all the factors that could affect your skin. Then, we create a customized skincare plan just for you. On average, our 3-product system will feature at least 35 active ingredients selected for your specific needs. We’ve analyzed thousands of scientific papers and consumer reviews to identify the most efficacious ingredients and concentrations for each individual.


In addition, we own the U.S. Patent for the Skin Genome Project™, which protects the use of personalization in skincare and solidifies our position as the leading personalized skincare brand in the industry. We’re also the only company with the ability to continuously monitor changes in our customers' geographical location, age, and lifestyle, and adjust their skincare formulations in real time.


**Curology**


To receive personalized skincare products, customers begin by taking a brief quiz and submitting photos of their skin, which assists the Curology provider in better understanding their skin health and individual requirements. The provider then prescribes a personalized formula with a maximum of three active ingredients that are specifically targeted to address the customer's particular concerns—most of which fall under the categories of "acne" or "aging”. (In contrast, our system features 30+ active ingredients on average.)


While Curology owns a couple of U.S. patents related to treating acne and photoaging, the patents seemingly lack the data-driven appeal of PROVEN’s hyper-individualized products.


### The Verdict: PROVEN Skincare is Your Ultimate Skin Solution


For those tired of the trial-and-error, PROVEN offers personalized, effective, dynamic skincare solutions backed by rigorous scientific research and advanced AI technology.


## Personalization Factor & Simplicity


**PROVEN**


In addition to progressively increasing active ingredients and continuously adapting to your lifestyle, our formulations are also designed to evolve with seasonal changes. As summer rolls around, for example, our clients might see their SPF levels increase to protect them against the higher UV index. In the winter, some of our clients with dry skin may see more moisturizing ingredients, like allantoin, in their night cream. We firmly believe that great skincare should be simple—but the path to great skin can often be complicated by excess products. Our clinically effective, 3-step regimen makes it easy.


How does it work? Each unique PROVEN system is dynamic, and formulated with the utmost precision, perpetually adapting to changes in lifestyle, environment, and skin concerns—including life events like cross-country moves or pregnancy. We also factor in what active ingredients can and cannot mix together, eliminating any worries about taxing your skin. Each custom formula has the right ingredients and concentration to effectively clear and nourish your skin without irritation.


**Curology**


Curology’s approach to personalization requires upfront work—customers must take a short skin quiz and upload pictures of their skin in order to receive their products. Their rationale for the process centers around the fact that a specialized professional analyzes the results to develop a customized formula. However, the only product that offers any form of customization is their acne line—and even so, they only choose from three active ingredients. The result? You’ll likely need to purchase more products to address your skin’s needs.


### The Verdict: PROVEN Creates Clinically Effective Skin Treatments for Evolving Concerns


One of our key differentiators is that we automatically adjust your formulations based on your life and ever-evolving needs. If you’re going through lifestyle changes like moving to a new city or becoming pregnant, your skin will naturally fluctuate. Our personalized routine provides a solution to maximize your skin health throughout every situation.
